name: Classic Paint
summary:
## Create. Relax. Express Yourself.

**Classic Paint** brings the timeless experience of painting into virtual reality.

Step into your own creative space, pick up a brush, choose your colors, and start creating. Whether you have a specific idea in mind or simply want to experiment, Classic Paint gives you an intuitive and enjoyable way to paint in VR.

### 🎨 Paint Your Way

Create at your own pace and explore your imagination directly in virtual reality.
